source_caption:
🎬 Transparent (2014–2019)

Transparent follows the Pfefferman family, a wealthy but emotionally complicated Los Angeles household whose lives begin to change when their parent, Maura Pfefferman, comes out as a transgender woman later in life. After spending decades hiding her true identity, Maura begins embracing her authentic self while navigating the challenges of transitioning, rebuilding relationships, and seeking acceptance from her family. Her three adult children, Sarah, Josh, and Ali, are each struggling with their own complicated relationships, personal identities, and uncertain futures, making the revelation both emotional and transformative. As the family attempts to understand Maura’s journey, long-buried secrets, unresolved conflicts, and unexpected personal discoveries begin to emerge. From awkward family gatherings and romantic complications to difficult conversations, emotional confrontations, and moments of personal growth, the Pfeffermans confront the complicated realities of love, identity, and belonging. Meanwhile, Maura explores new friendships, relationships, and communities while learning to navigate a world that often challenges her sense of acceptance and independence. As each family member searches for happiness and self-understanding, their experiences reveal how personal transformation can affect everyone around them. Combining heartfelt comedy, emotional drama, complex characters, and intimate storytelling, the series explores family, identity, acceptance, relationships, self-discovery, and the courage required to live authentically.

🎭 Genre: Comedy-Drama • Family Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 27–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Joey Soloway

source_details.synopsis: Transparent is an American comedy-drama television series created by Joey Soloway for Amazon Studios that debuted on February 6, 2014. The story revolves around a Los Angeles family, the Pfeffermans, and their lives after learning that their parent (Jeffrey Tambor) is a trans woman now going by the name Maura. Transparent's first season premiered in full on September 26, 2014, and its second season on December 11, 2015, third season on September 23, 2016, and fourth season on September 21, 2017.
